expectations.text: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
expectations.evidence: "this is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase. Each file is small and single-purpose, which feels tidy, but 'single-purpose' is the wrong test here."

expectations.text: Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
expectations.evidence: "merge them into one UserBadge.tsx... JSX + the 40 lines of logic + prop types"; types co-located unless genuinely shared.

expectations.text: Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell (cross-file context the agent won't fetch)
expectations.evidence: "Getting an agent to proactively open an adjacent file is like pulling teeth... makes confident edits that break because it never checked how a prop or type was shaped one file over." A view 'just JSX' can't be understood without the logic shaping its props.

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely isolatable styles as a defensible separate file (does not blanket-merge everything)
expectations.evidence: "UserBadge.styles.ts — this one's defensible. Styles are reference data the agent rarely needs to reason about... leaving it separate is fine."
